_comment: Golden outputs captured by actually compiling BonusCalc.cbl with GnuCOBOL (cobc -x) and running the resulting binary. This is real ground truth, not hand-computed - the migrated Java output is diffed against THIS file, not against what a human thinks the answer should be.

cases.why_this_matters: years>=10 but salary is NOT >1000000, so this must fall to the 0.15 ELSE branch, not the 0.12 high-salary branch. A migration that flips '>' to '>=' or mis-nests this IF will silently pass tiers 1-4 and only fail here. This is the exact class of bug AST/compile validation CANNOT catch - only behavioral diffing against real COBOL output catches it.
